issues.title: Final audit does not reject newly added untested files
issues.finding: The final audit recomputes hashes only for previously listed plan.sourcePaths. The working inventory and modification-scope scan run during quality only. Adding a new unlisted source/API file or an extra migration after quality and committing it with the artifact can leave every audited source hash unchanged; metadata then labels the new full artifact tree as testedTree.
issues.requiredChange: At final audit, validate all changed and untracked files against the phase-start baseline and modificationScope; recompute and compare the complete implementation/test/tool inventory, allowing the actual dynamically bound migration explicitly. Require exactly the two prerequisite migrations plus this one migration. Reject any unbound new file before artifact sealing.

issues.title: Setup failures are not automatically recorded as immutable attempts
issues.finding: The setup catch prints the error and sets exitCode but writes no attempt.json and preserves no partial command record. Attempt 1 was retained by the root agent separately. A later setup failure could otherwise be absent from the phase history; the existing-config success branch also returns without requiring the successful PostgreSQL setup receipt.
issues.requiredChange: Persist each setup failure once in the current attempt with command, reason, plan binding and safe partial observations. Do not overwrite prior failure evidence. Validate or safely complete the task-owned successful setup receipt when reusing an existing configuration.

issues.title: Previous failure receipts can disappear without blocking final audit
issues.finding: Retry and audit bind only each previous frozen-plan file and its hash, not the corresponding failure attempt.json. Removing a prior failure receipt while retaining its frozen plan would still satisfy these checks; metadata inventories only the evidence files that remain.
issues.requiredChange: Bind prior failure receipt path and SHA-256 when freezing the retry, and require every previous receipt to exist with matching phase, attempt, non-PASS status and frozen plan hash. Include the verified immutable failure receipt in the final evidence input set.

issues.title: Migration generation accepts echoed or incomplete command records
issues.finding: The predicate only looks for a command containing --create-only, exitCode 0 and a falsy timedOut. Both an echo command and a record missing timeout/stdout/stderr were accepted by the extracted real function. The actual existing generation receipt is correct; the issue is its validator.
issues.requiredChange: Require the exact permitted Phase008 Prisma migration command, timedOut === false, string stdout/stderr and complete successful command observations. Reuse the strict generation binding validation in the finalizer and add rejection probes for echoed/wrong-phase commands and missing execution fields.

issues.title: Two records from the same shell satisfy dual-shell admission
issues.finding: The admission checks require two successful entries but do not bind their distinct shell identities. Replacing the second entry with a clone of PowerShell7 was accepted. The actual current preflight contains both required shells and is correct.
issues.requiredChange: Require exactly PowerShell7 and WindowsPowerShell51, appropriate actual command identities, ROOT_LAYOUT_PHASE_CHECKPOINT_SEAL scope and protocolFixture === false along with the existing phase/commit/PASS bindings.
